master.title: Master: AI, Computer Vision
master.description: At the **MUIARFID**, I have deepened my knowledge in **artificial intelligence**, **machine learning**, **computer vision**, **pattern recognition** and other advanced AI skills. I have also had the opportunity to work on real-world projects and collaborate with industry professionals.

erasmus.title: Erasmus: 4th Year of the Degree
erasmus.description: During my academic exchange in Switzerland, I learned how to create **AI models**, **advanced algorithms**, and **data analysis**. All with a practical as well as a theoretical approach. At the same time, I have been able to practice and improve my **English** by interacting with people from all over the world.

upv.title: Degree in Computer Engineering
upv.description: At **UPV**, I have learned everything from the basic concepts of computing to how to develop applications and use **artificial intelligence**. All of this, while achieving excellent grades and receiving awards for it. During this process, I have participated in various university activities such as sports championships, student delegation, or as a tutor.

eso_bach.title: Secondary Education and Baccalaureate
eso_bach.description: During my adolescence, I studied at **IES Almenara**, the institute in my town. I completed compulsory secondary education (ESO) and the scientific **baccalaureate** with the aim of taking the university entrance exams.
